name: servicesphere-root
description: Root workspace — infrastructure scripts only. App code lives in server/ and client/.

scripts.test: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm run test --prefix server" "npm run test --prefix client"
scripts.test:coverage: concurrently "npm run test:coverage --prefix server" "npm run test:coverage --prefix client"
scripts.test:ci: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm run test:ci --prefix server" "npm run test:ci --prefix client"
